identity: A short Modern Standard Arabic student composition / spoken-essay draft (موضوع تعبير او كلمة) on التسامح. Structure: a thesis paragraph (definition of tolerance, its necessity, then the metadiscursive announcement لذلك سوف أتحدث اليوم عن بعض الطرق لتعزيز ثقافة التسامح في المجتمع), one <NL>, then a single long body paragraph that enumerates concrete proposals — social-media awareness campaigns pushed through influencers, roadside billboards, school curricula, TV adverts, entertainment programmes — and closes with a peroration (وفي النهاية أرى أنه من المهم…). Informal register, loose agreement (لينشروه resuming حملات), heavy reliance on coordinated verbal nouns, and one visible seam where a lost sentence break left the word الناس doubled. By 0e this is genre C (modern essay / op-ed): its native unit is the clause-sized information chunk, not the orthographic sentence.
law: Clause-chunk genre. Pass 1 finds nothing: no cataphoric announcer, no dangling stem, no run of bare parallel siblings, no heading, ordinal, table, verse or option list — so the whole answer rests on Pass 2, and §0 plus §0d arbitrate every site. Default at every و is CUT and I must justify not cutting, never the reverse (my measured prior is 7:1 toward over-merging). The conjunct-weight test decides: a conjunct that brings a new predicate PLUS material of its own (its own object, PP, purpose clause, frame) opens a unit; a bare noun or adjective conjunct hanging off the same predicate does not. The spine of this document is a chain of coordinated masdars (نشر… ونشرها… ونشر… ونشرها…، شراء… ورفعها…، صنع… وصنع…) that are grammatically all complements of one يجب but informationally an enumeration of separate proposals — G2 and F1 rule that weight beats syntax, so each heavy masdar is its own unit. Standing brakes applied: material coordinated INSIDE a purpose clause (ل… / كي…) never opens a unit however heavy; bare-noun و never cuts; fronted frames (وفي النهاية) and additive markers (وأيضا) always cut; asyndetic clause seams always cut in this genre (0f, D3). Mandatory: ¶ at ⟨26⟩ المجتمع (token before the single <NL>) and at ⟨170⟩ المجتمع (final token).
reasoning: SITE ⟨14⟩ / ⟨42⟩ / ⟨91⟩ — the three لذلك / ولذلك.
